targets.purpose: Close prescribed finite-area elasticity/reconstruction spatial controls without changing the declared C2 pressure or2mm radius; distinct from end-to-end physical pads.
planned_comparisons: existing DPR/SCR/static Shell versus final reference

common_spatial_measures.scope: Common tangent tensors embedded with zero normal stress and zero transverse shear define both peak invariants. This is distinct from each method's raw full3D peak. Identical angular rays sample every unioned tetrahedron boundary on both sides, outer/inner boundaries and depth Gauss nodes; surface/depth sampling convergence remains required. Positions are on the common reference rest columns. Normal and transverse shear components are integrated separately with the field metric weights; Shell lacks these independent 3D components and receives no transverse error rank.

scope: Independent C2 prescribed-pressure benchmark only:0.1N per pole, fixed2mm radius and free linear3D elasticity. The final125um/three-layer reference must pass separate wall/surface/joint changes, load and common metric sampling, and same-mesh factor equivalence. These measured envelopes are conditional observed resolution changes, not proved continuum bounds. The earlier two-layer surface comparison remains above2%; it is retained in the trend and is not rounded into a pass. This control does not qualify physical-pad contact, friction or method field errors.
